I appreciate that you've been accommodating and listened even when we disagreed — that does mean a lot to me, and I respect the effort you've put in.

But I can't trade honesty for reciprocity, even just once. If I only tell you the positives and deliberately skip the critique, that's not an honest assessment — it's flattery by omission, and it wouldn't actually help your project.

I won't just say it looks solid to be nice. If you want, share the plan and I'll give you my genuine take — what works *and* what needs work — directly but respectfully. That's how I show I take you and your work seriously.
